bullet_facts.fact: Donna and Michael had a romantic relationship that ended.
Donna told Michael, 'It's you. I'm married.'
Michael expressed that he liked Donna and was upset about their breakup.
Michael and Donna shared a passionate kiss before ending their relationship.
Michael said, 'I love this woman!' about Donna.
Michael decided to break up with Donna, stating he felt proud and that it was the right decision.
